item.title: d4v41 and Jinggg leave Paper Rex after 7th–8th Champions finish, Pacific place secure
item.description:
Paper Rex has parted with captain d4v41 and Jinggg, two Masters Toronto winners, after an early exit at Champions 2026. With its VCT Pacific partner place secure, the Singapore organisation is rebuilding by choice as free agency opens to every region.

The post d4v41 and Jinggg leave Paper Rex after 7th–8th Champions finish, Pacific place secure appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.description:
KRÜ Blaze beat Shopify Rebellion Gold 3-1 in the lower bracket final of the VCT Game Changers Championship 2026, four days after losing to them.

The post KRÜ Blaze recover from opening map loss to beat Shopify Rebellion Gold and reach final appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.title: Gentle Mates GC come from a map down to beat Shopify Rebellion Gold and reach Game Changers final
item.description:
Gentle Mates GC, on their Championship debut, beat Shopify Rebellion Gold 2-1 in the upper bracket final in São Paulo. The French-based side go into Sunday's best-of-five grand final with a two-map ban advantage, while Shopify Rebellion Gold must come through the lower final.

The post Gentle Mates GC come from a map down to beat Shopify Rebellion Gold and reach Game Changers final appeared first on Esports Insider.
